verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vercel runs on-demand server-side code through Fluid compute [vercel-docs-19] and production workloads in isolated containers [vercel-docs-12]. Community comments describe Vercel as a 'nodejs as a service' provider [vercel-comm-10] that supports JS/TS/Go [vercel-comm-14]. Nothing explicitly says the functions run unmodified Node.js with full npm package compatibility rather than a restricted runtime subset. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full Node.js runtime in functions, npm package and native-module compatibility details, a comparison of edge versus serverless runtime restrictions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
